content.text: Enjoy Lakefront Nature Camping in Mawsynram, Meghalaya at best price. This well-equipped campground is tucked comfortably in a beautiful green environment surrounded by deep forests, spectacular mountains, caverns, and a clean lake at the fore. Enjoy your holiday in the dome tents and cottage tents, which provide standard facilities such as restrooms, air mattresses, and camping mats. Hiking, kayaking, fishing, swimming, and caving are some of the activities available at the campsite. This campground is located in Mawsynram's Phlang Mawsyrpat Village.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Enjoy camping in the world's wettest location, Mawsynram, which is endowed with lush greenery
Wake up by the sounds of chirping of birds and enjoy the natural surroundings of the campground and the breeze from the lake
Enjoy bird viewing and other exciting activities like fishing, hiking, kayaking (at your own cost)
Watch the stars under the glow of a campfire in the middle of the deep forest

main.title: Lakefront Nature Camping in Mawsynram, Meghalaya Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival and Camping
items: When you arrive at the campground, you will be amazed by the breathtaking scenery.
Get settled inside your tent and relax.
Following noon, go for walking, fishing, kayaking, swimming, and caving at the campground (on your own).
Observe migrating birds while enjoying evening munchies.
After supper, gather your friends around a warm bonfire.
Spend the night comfortably in your tents.

days.title: Day 2 : Departure
items: Wake up in your comfortable camp bed and have your delicious breakfast.
Check out of your campsite and return to the city with wonderful recollections.

content.text: You can reach Mawsynram campsite by taking a car or state transport bus from Shillong which takes about 60 km.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursed will be made against missed services.
Travelers are required to show their valid identity card and the booking voucher at the time of check-in to the campsite.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
Unmarried couples are not allowed to stay in one tent.
Transportation including pick up from and drop to the campsite is not included in the package. ·
The menu for dinner is not fixed and may vary depending upon availability.

In case of bad weather conditions, if camping may not be feasible, we will try to arrange a homestay for you and it may incur extra costs payable by you. In the event of non-availability of homestay, the camping booking shall stand cancelled with applicable refunds.

There may be some days/months during monsoon when private camping may not be available. In that event we will arrange normal camping for you and the amount difference shall be refunded to you within 7(seven) business days in your bank account.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Lakefront Nature Camping in Mawsynram, Meghalaya

items.question: 1. Is breakfast provided at the Mawsynram Campsite?

answer.text: Yes, breakfast will be available at Mawsynram Campsite.

items.question: 2. Does camping at Mawsynram provide bedding, blankets and pillows?

answer.text: Yes, bedding, blankets, and pillows are given for your camping trip and are included in the Mawsynram Camping Package.

items.question: 3. Is there a bonfire or campfire arrangement at the campsite during the stay?

answer.text: Yes, a bonfire or a campfire is provided during the Mawsynram Camping.

items.question: 4. Is there a parking facility available at the campsite?

answer.text: Yes, there is a parking facility inside the Mawsynram Campsite for two-wheelers as well as four-wheelers.

items.question: 5. Does the Mawsynram Campsite have luggage storage facilities?

answer.text: Yes, you can keep your belongings inside your tents and in case you have anything costly, you can keep it with the campsite owner.
